The mystery deepens when young Stella Meredith, whose mother supposedly died falling from the nearby cliff, is drawn compulsively to the house and nearly goes over the same precipice. Rick investigates the old Meredith household and learns of Mary Meredith, her husbandâ€™s Spanish model Carmel, and a long-buried scandal. The accepted story says Carmel was the dangerous rival, but the hauntings reveal the opposite truth: Stella is actually Carmelâ€™s daughter, and Mary Meredith was the jealous woman who tried to kill the child and died at the cliff. grh_ed55eca25ed0311f5d0f.title: Ten Meter Romance
paragraphs: Albert Holly becomes lonely and despondent after his daughter Ethel marries and moves to the Philippines. Dr. Christian steers him toward amateur radio, and the ten-meter band gives Albert a new purpose: he can speak with Ethel across the ocean and eventually becomes a regular on-air friend of widowed operator Mrs. Winters. The nightly conversations cure the vague 'heart trouble' Albert had been complaining about and grow into a romance even though the two have never met face to face. When Ethel's family prepares to return closer to home, Albert decides to invite Mrs. Winters to Rivers End and ask her to marry him, with Dr. Christian coaching him to make the proposal as simply over the radio as he would make any other call.
